svg.title: Chains of places: how far up before anything is recorded
svg.text: linked all the way down to the cave
municipality of Ermionida (green) in the Argolis regional unit
Wikidata separates the ancient region from today's
regional unit; the GND keeps both in one record and
gives it two entity types, gik and gin.
only recorded two levels further up
Manggarai regency (green) on the island of Flores
SISAL 104 · no QID, no OSM object
An island group, not an administrative unit: the
GND has a record, OSM has no relation, Wikidata has
The GND record 4228929-4 for the cave has not changed since 2021 — Q1441331 does not point at it, and the record itself carries no coordinate. Of the two gaps,
the link is the smaller one.
